validationChecks.check: Every postal code is exactly 5 numeric digits (^[0-9]{5}$)
All 17 first-level divisions represented in respective category partitions
Special City (Seoul) accurately preserved with 01-09 prefixes
6 Metropolitan Cities (Busan, Daegu, Incheon, Gwangju, Daejeon, Ulsan) isolated
Elevated Special Self-Governing Provinces (Gangwon 2023, Jeonbuk 2024, Jeju 2006) preserved
Road-name addresses (도로명주소) and Lot addresses (지번주소) bilingual fields preserved
Leading zeros strictly preserved for Seoul/Incheon/Gyeonggi codes
